name: Richelieu Foods Inc
old_description: For more than a century, Richelieu Foods has built its legacy on craftsmanship, commitment, and partnership. Founded in 1862, we’ve grown from a regional operation into a trusted private brand manufacturer known across retail, co-manufacturing, co-packing and foodservice channels.
about:
Richelieu Foods was founded in 1862 in Beaver Dam, Wisconsin, beginning as a regional operation before evolving into a private-brand manufacturer. In 2018, the company joined the Freiberger Group, a wholly owned subsidiary of Südzucker AG, expanding its reach to a network of 11 locations across Europe and the United States.

The company specializes in private-label pizza programs for retail, co-manufacturing, co-packing, and foodservice channels. Its in-house R&D team applies market research and trend analysis to develop products, while flexible manufacturing and packaging options support efficient production at scale.

Richelieu Foods serves national retailers, foodservice operators, and brands seeking private-label frozen pizza and deli solutions. Customers include leading retailers and manufacturers that rely on the company to scale private brand offerings, reduce risk, and accelerate growth.

The company emphasizes a partnership-driven model, offering tailored co-creation, pricing analysis, consumer insights, and trend monitoring. It treats each client's label as its own, aiming to deliver seamless customization and reliable execution from concept to full-scale production.
